result.reason: The operative language achieves a 12-month documentation-conformance warranty measured from acceptance and retains correction, replacement, and conditional refund remedies. However, it does not provide the required professional-and-workmanlike services warranty, a separate 90-day services period, or a compliance-with-laws warranty. The malicious-code warranty is also improperly limited to code that was “willfully introduced.” Applying the 12-month period to both Software and the MarketSite.net Service may exceed the playbook’s requested services duration, so the revision is not narrowly tailored. The margin comment cannot cure these operative omissions. Drafting is further weakened by the incomplete “shall not apply only if:” language and stray disclaimer text.
